column1: # loader_requests_coldboot121.tsv -- every windowed-read request (FUN_002aac80) the title issued on the loader
# object fs=0xbb3560 during a deterministic 121-frame coldboot (NEW dev leg, loader.ring_cache=off; the list is
# the title's, independent of the fill rule): handle 0 = DATA/DATA.BH (fs+0x2c = 0, 27376 B), handle 1 =
# DATA/DATA.BD segments at fs+0x2c = 0x3b2ce0 (5 requests) and 0xfd4e6 = Startup\Default.rm2 (900 requests,
# 0x261a19 B). pos = fs+0x2c + off (BD-absolute); tick = the domain tick of the request.
